description: The Catastro de Concesiones Mineras is Chile's official map of mining concessions, showing exploitation concessions under the 1983 and 1932 mining codes, exploration concessions and older claims (estacamentos) as polygons, with filters by holder name, holder tax number, concession name and concession roll number, and tools to measure, draw geometries and check a user's own polygons, points or lines for overlap with existing concessions. It is published by the Servicio Nacional de Geología y Minería (Sernageomin), using coordinates from the official database of its Mining Property Department. Coverage is national for Chile; the page stated it was updated on 28 September 2026 at 07:25, the day of access. The map is free online as an ArcGIS web application; users can upload TXT, CSV or zipped shapefiles in PSAD56 or SAD69 UTM zones 18S and 19S for overlap checks. Caveats: Sernageomin states that the positions shown are only indicative because concessions were registered in PSAD56 or SAD69 and the base map is reprojected, the page gives no bulk download or licence, and the site is in Spanish. For simulation it shows where mining rights sit relative to water, power, transport and settlements, for hazard exposure and planning studies of mining regions. It is related to the Cochilco copper and minerals statistics yearbook record in this catalogue, which gives Chilean mining output.
